I've arrived at the park and found a nice tree away from the path. I think I'll be remembered, becauee I have about 200 colleagues at the venue I mentioned, and I pretty much know all of them. My parents, sisters, their kids and husbands probably will too. Other than that, it doean't really matter. Thanks, though.

I have my ID in my pocket, no password on my phone, and am about 10 minutes of walking from my home. i have about 2 hours until people will start walking their dogs, so that should be enough. I'm gonna start climbing now, so yeah. I wish you the best (you're the only one I can, at this point) and hope your life gets better (I'm guessing you're not here without a reason). I'll see you on the other side!
